payload.acceptance_criteria:
ledger_write_in_flight and is_held check the frozen marker first: a frozen or non-folder ledger means no write in flight. They do not catch every OSError, so a real lock problem still stops a push.
A held lock in an unfrozen ledger still refuses the push.
payload.description:
## Context
When a repository's ledger is frozen after migrate --freeze, I want git push to work, so the vault cutover does not block every push. Cutover rehearsal 2026-11-19 13:04 UTC: .basicly/ledger is the frozen marker file; pre-push.py:86 ledger_write_in_flight calls kit tracker/locking.py:75 is_held, which runs os.open on .basicly/ledger/.events.lock and raises NotADirectoryError. The hook crashes and the push is refused. Blocks dev-dqsc6. Lane harness/dev-frozen-push. Orchestrator decision 2026-11-19 13:04 UTC.
payload.title: pre-push crashes in a repository whose ledger is frozen
